purpose: Targeted tree inputs, repeated paired timings, operation counts and formal limit calibration.
notes: Screening timings are single runs used only to select candidates.
Confirm and pivot use seven runs; scale uses five. Calibration adds two formal inputs with seven runs.
Each stage preserves its original generator and binary hashes. The calibration stage regenerated all eleven confirmed inputs within the formal limits and checked their hashes and input contracts.
Only inputs within the published size limits enter calibration.summary; 2x and 4x inputs are experiments.
The limit uses standard-program time, multiplier 2, and 0.5-second upward rounding.
Peak working sets include process overhead. Instrumented runs provide counts only, never timing results.
